CvBuilder.title: UpNext CV Studio
CvBuilder.subtitle: Turn real experience into evidence for every opportunity

save.privateDescription: Content is saved in this browser for this account and has not been sent to the server.

targeting.title: Which opportunity is this CV for?
targeting.subtitle: Every job needs a focused story. Paste the job description and UpNext will show which requirements already have evidence in your CV—using transparent rules and never inventing content.
targeting.formDescription: Use the exact role and company name to keep this CV intentional.
targeting.descriptionPlaceholder: Paste the responsibilities, requirements and skills from the job post…
targeting.descriptionHint: UpNext only compares keywords with content you have written. Add a skill only when you can support it with real evidence.
targeting.matchDescription: Which requirements already appear in your experience, projects or skills?
targeting.coverageValue: Your CV covers {score} percent of the identified keywords
targeting.noMatchedKeywords: No matching evidence has been found in your CV yet.
targeting.noMissingKeywords: No notable gaps remain among the identified keywords.
targeting.notAtsScore: This is content coverage—not an “ATS score” or hiring prediction.
targeting.emptyMatchTitle: Paste a job description to begin
targeting.emptyMatchDescription: UpNext will identify up to 14 notable keywords and show where each one is supported.

principles.evidenceDescription: Connect each skill to a specific experience or project.
principles.truthDescription: UpNext only analyzes what you provide and always explains the result.
principles.versionDescription: Prioritize the most relevant content instead of sending one CV everywhere.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.subtitle: State the exact target role and contact details a recruiter can use immediately.
personal.websiteHint: You can enter a URL with or without https://

summary.title: Professional summary
summary.subtitle: Help recruiters understand your seniority, specialty and value in the first few seconds.
summary.label: Short introduction
summary.placeholder: Example: Frontend Developer with 3 years of experience building SaaS products with React and TypeScript…
summary.hint: Prefer concrete evidence; avoid generic claims such as “hard-working fast learner”.
summary.formula: Role + years of experience + core specialty + one measurable result + next career direction.

experience.title: Work experience
experience.subtitle: List the newest role first; describe actions, scope and verifiable results.
experience.emptyDescription: If you are just starting, you can hide this section and use Projects to demonstrate your ability.
experience.descriptionPlaceholder:
• Built…
• Optimized… reducing processing time by 30%
experience.descriptionHint: Start each line with a strong action verb and include outcomes where possible.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.subtitle: Choose projects relevant to your target role and clarify the work you personally owned.
projects.emptyDescription: A project with source code or a live demo helps IT candidates prove practical skills.
projects.name: Project name
projects.descriptionPlaceholder: The problem, your contribution, and the result…
projects.descriptionHint: Do not claim the whole team's work; make your individual contribution clear.

education.title: Education
education.subtitle: Add relevant programs; include GPA and achievements only when they strengthen your application.
education.emptyDescription: Add a degree, major or training program relevant to your career.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Prioritize 5–10 skills found in your target job description that you can demonstrate.
skills.emptyDescription: Add your core technologies, languages and working methods.
skills.name: Skill name
skills.guide: UpNext uses clear text labels instead of ambiguous percentage bars, helping recruiters interpret proficiency.

review.title: CV readiness
review.subtitle: UpNext checks required data and provides actionable suggestions. This score is not a hiring assessment.
review.readyTitle: Your CV is ready to export
review.readyDescription: No required issues remain. The current preview is approximately {pages} A4 pages.
review.needsWorkDescription: Fix {count} required issues before printing or saving a PDF.
review.insightsDescription: These signals come from your actual CV content, not a hiring score.
review.keywordCoverageEmpty: Add a job description to compare your CV.
review.measurableImpactDescription: Numbers make the scope and impact of your contribution easier to verify.
review.skillEvidenceDescription: {evidenced}/{total} skills also appear in your summary, experience or projects.
review.jobEvidenceDescription: Do not stuff keywords. Add one only when real experience supports it.
review.checklistDescription: Required issues appear before improvement suggestions.
review.noIssues: No issues found. You can continue to Design or export your PDF.

styling.title: CV design
styling.subtitle: Choose a fitting style while preserving a clear structure for people and ATS systems.
styling.sectionsHint: Contact details remain fixed at the top. Rename, reorder or hide the remaining sections.

profileSync.button: Import real data from UpNext Profile
profileSync.dialogDescription: UpNext will use information currently saved in your candidate profile.
profileSync.replaceTitle: Current CV content will be replaced
profileSync.replaceDescription: Personal details, experience, education, projects and skills will be updated. Your design choices remain, and you can Undo.
profileSync.success: Draft updated from UpNext Profile. You can Undo if needed.
profileSync.error: Profile is currently unavailable. Your on-device draft is safe and remains fully editable.

clearDialog.title: Clear all CV content?
clearDialog.description: Entered information will be removed from the on-device draft. Design choices remain, and you can Undo afterward.

exportValidation.title: Your CV is not ready to export
exportValidation.description: Fix {count} required issues to avoid sending an incomplete CV.

pdfGuide.title: Print or save your CV as PDF
pdfGuide.subtitle: UpNext uses your browser's secure print dialog and does not upload this draft to the server.
pdfGuide.destination: Choose “Save as PDF” if you want to download a file.
pdfGuide.margin: Choose “None” for margins because the CV already includes A4 spacing.
pdfGuide.graphics: Enable “Background graphics” to preserve the template accent.
pdfGuide.headerFooter: Disable browser headers and footers so the URL and date are not printed.

assistant.progressHint: Complete key content first, then review and design.

validation.phoneInvalid: Phone numbers should contain 7 to 15 digits.
validation.summaryTooShort: Aim for at least 60 characters so the summary is specific.
validation.experienceRecommended: Consider adding experience or hiding this section if it does not apply.
validation.descriptionTooShort: Aim for at least 60 characters and focus on outcomes.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
validation.projectRecommended: Consider adding at least one relevant project.
validation.projectRoleRequired: Enter your role in the project.
validation.projectDescriptionTooShort: Describe the problem, your contribution and the result.
validation.projectUrlInvalid: Enter a valid source code URL.
validation.educationRecommended: Consider adding education or hiding this section.
validation.skillNameRequired: Enter a skill name or remove the empty row.
validation.duplicateSkills: A skill is duplicated; keep each skill once.
validation.careerEvidenceRequired: Add at least one Experience, Project or Education entry so recruiters have evidence to assess.
